passages.text: After Ehud died, the Israelites again did evil in the sight of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Ehud was a leader of Israel.
Ehud died.
After Ehud died, the Israelites did evil.
The Israelites did what was wrong in the sight of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵה֖וּד מֵֽת׃

passages.text: So the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his forces was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave the Israelites into the power of Jabin.
Jabin was the king of Canaan.
Jabin ruled in the city of Hazor.
Sisera was the commander of Jabin’s army.
Sisera lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
passages.original: וַיִּמְכְּרֵ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה בְּיַד֙ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחָצ֑וֹר וְשַׂר־ צְבָאוֹ֙ סִֽיסְרָ֔א וְה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בַּחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, because Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron, and he had harshly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
Jabin was the king of Canaan.
Jabin ruled from Hazor.
Sisera was Jabin's army commander.
Sisera lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
Jabin had nine hundred chariots made of iron.
Jabin and Sisera oppressed the Israelites.
They treated the Israelites harshly.
They oppressed the Israelites for twenty years.
The Israelites suffered greatly.
The Israelites cried out to the LORD for help.
passages.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֠י תְּשַׁ֨ע מֵא֤וֹת רֶֽכֶב־ בַּרְזֶל֙ ל֔וֹ וְ֠הוּא לָחַ֞ץ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּחָזְקָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
passages.sermon:
Deborah was a woman.
Deborah was a prophetess.
Deborah was the wife of Lappidoth.
Deborah judged Israel at that time.
passages.original: וּדְבוֹרָה֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה נְבִיאָ֔ה אֵ֖שֶׁת לַפִּיד֑וֹת הִ֛יא שֹׁפְטָ֥ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃

passages.text: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, where the Israelites would go up to her for judgment.
passages.sermon:
Deborah was a prophetess and the wife of Lappidoth.
She judged Israel at that time.
She sat under the Palm of Deborah.
This tree stood between Ramah and Bethel.
It was in the hill country of Ephraim.
The Israelites went up to her there.
They came to her for judgment.
passages.original: וְ֠הִיא יוֹשֶׁ֨בֶת תַּֽחַת־ תֹּ֜מֶר דְּבוֹרָ֗ה בֵּ֧ין הָרָמָ֛ה וּבֵ֥ין בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֵלֶ֛יהָ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: She summoned Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, “Surely the LORD, the God of Israel, is commanding you: ‘Go and march to Mount Tabor, taking with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.
passages.sermon:
Deborah was a prophetess and the wife of Lappidoth.
Deborah judged Israel at that time.
Deborah sent for Barak.
Barak was the son of Abinoam.
Barak lived in Kedesh, in the land of Naphtali.
Deborah spoke to Barak.
Deborah said, “The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD commands you.
Go to Mount Tabor.
Take ten thousand men with you.
Take men from Naphtali.
Take men from Zebulun.”
passages.original: וַתִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַתִּקְרָא֙ לְבָרָ֣ק בֶּן־ אֲבִינֹ֔עַם מִקֶּ֖דֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַתֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הֲלֹ֥א צִוָּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵ֤ךְ וּמָֽשַׁכְתָּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר תָּב֔וֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ עִמְּךָ֗ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֔ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י וּמִבְּנֵ֥י זְבֻלֽוּן׃

passages.text: And I will draw out Sisera the commander of Jabin’s army, his chariots, and his troops to the River Kishon, and I will deliver him into your hand.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Barak through Deborah.
God promised to act.
God said, “I will bring Sisera to you.”
Sisera was the commander of Jabin’s army.
Sisera had chariots.
Sisera had many troops.
God said, “I will bring Sisera, his chariots, and his troops to the River Kishon.”
God said, “I will give Sisera into your hand.”
passages.original: וּמָשַׁכְתִּ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֗וֹן אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָא֙ שַׂר־ צְבָ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְאֶת־ רִכְבּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ הֲמוֹנ֑וֹ וּנְתַתִּ֖יהוּ בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
passages.sermon:
Barak was the son of Abinoam.
Deborah was a prophetess and a judge in Israel.
Barak spoke to Deborah.
Barak said, "If you go with me, I will go."
Barak also said, "If you do not go with me, I will not go."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ בָּרָ֔ק אִם־ תֵּלְכִ֥י עִמִּ֖י וְהָלָ֑כְתִּי וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תֵלְכִ֛י עִמִּ֖י לֹ֥א אֵלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: “I will certainly go with you,” Deborah replied, “but the road you are taking will bring you no honor, because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman.” So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh, where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.
passages.sermon:
Deborah was a prophetess and a judge in Israel.
Barak was an Israelite leader.
Deborah said, “I will go with you.”
She said, “You will not receive honor on the road you are taking.”
She said, “The LORD will deliver Sisera into the hand of a woman.”
Deborah got up.
Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh.
Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh.
Ten thousand men followed Barak on foot.
Deborah went up with Barak.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר הָלֹ֧ךְ אֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗ךְ אֶ֚פֶס כִּי֩ לֹ֨א תִֽהְיֶ֜ה תִּֽפְאַרְתְּךָ֗ עַל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה הוֹלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֣י בְֽיַד־ אִשָּׁ֔ה יִמְכֹּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָ֑א וַתָּ֧קָם דְּבוֹרָ֛ה וַתֵּ֥לֶך עִם־ בָּרָ֖ק קֶֽדְשָׁה׃ וַיַּזְעֵ֨ק בָּרָ֜ק אֶת־ זְבוּלֻ֤ן וְאֶת־ נַפְתָּלִי֙ קֶ֔דְשָׁה וַיַּ֣עַל בְּרַגְלָ֔יו עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אַלְפֵ֖י אִ֑ישׁ וַתַּ֥עַל עִמּ֖וֹ דְּבוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent by the great tree of Zaanannim, which was near Kedesh.
passages.sermon:
Heber was a Kenite.
The Kenites were descendants of Hobab.
Hobab was the father-in-law of Moses.
Heber separated from the other Kenites.
Heber set up his tent by the great tree of Zaanannim.
This tree was near Kedesh.
passages.original: וְחֶ֤בֶר הַקֵּינִי֙ נִפְרָ֣ד מִקַּ֔יִן מִבְּנֵ֥י חֹבָ֖ב חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֣ט אָהֳל֔וֹ עַד־ אֵל֥וֹן בַּצְעַנִּים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶת־ קֶֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor, he summoned all nine hundred of his iron chariots and all the men with him, from Harosheth-hagoyim to the River Kishon.
passages.sermon:
Sisera was a commander of the Canaanite army.
People told Sisera that Barak, the son of Abinoam, had gone up Mount Tabor.
Sisera heard this news.
Sisera called for all his chariots.
He had nine hundred iron chariots.
Sisera also called all the men who were with him.
They came from Harosheth-hagoyim.
Sisera led them to the River Kishon.
passages.original: וַיַּגִּ֖דוּ לְסִֽיסְרָ֑א כִּ֥י עָלָ֛ה בָּרָ֥ק בֶּן־ אֲבִינֹ֖עַם הַר־ תָּבֽוֹר׃ס וַיַּזְעֵ֨ק סִֽיסְרָ֜א אֶת־ כָּל־ רִכְבּ֗וֹ תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֣כֶב בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ מֵחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶל־ נַ֥חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Arise, for this is the day that the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the LORD gone before you?” So Barak came down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him.
passages.sermon:
Deborah was a prophet and a judge in Israel.
Barak was the son of Abinoam.
Deborah spoke to Barak.
She said, “Get up.
Today is the day.
The LORD has given Sisera into your hand.
The LORD goes before you.”
Barak came down from Mount Tabor.
Ten thousand men followed Barak.
passages.original: וַתֹּאמֶר֩ דְּבֹרָ֨ה אֶל־ בָּרָ֜ק ק֗וּם כִּ֣י זֶ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָא֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ הֲלֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בָּרָק֙ מֵהַ֣ר תָּב֔וֹר וַעֲשֶׂ֧רֶת אֲלָפִ֛ים אִ֖ישׁ אַחֲרָֽיו׃

passages.text: And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera, all his charioteers, and all his army. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.
passages.sermon:
The LORD fought against Sisera.
The LORD fought against all the chariots of Sisera.
The LORD fought against all the army of Sisera.
The LORD used the sword to defeat them.
The LORD did this in front of Barak.
Sisera left his chariot.
Sisera ran away on foot.
passages.original: וַיָּ֣הָם יְ֠הוָה אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָ֨א וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֧כֶב וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה לְפִי־ חֶ֖רֶב לִפְנֵ֣י בָרָ֑ק וַיֵּ֧רֶד סִֽיסְרָ֛א מֵעַ֥ל הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֖ה וַיָּ֥נָס בְּרַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim, and the whole army of Sisera fell by the sword; not a single man was left.
passages.sermon:
Barak was a leader of Israel’s army.
Barak chased Sisera’s chariots.
Barak also chased Sisera’s army.
He pursued them all the way to Harosheth-hagoyim.
Sisera’s entire army fell by the sword.
No one in Sisera’s army survived.
Not a single man was left.
passages.original: וּבָרָ֗ק רָדַ֞ף אַחֲרֵ֤י הָרֶ֙כֶב֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה עַ֖ד חֲרֹ֣שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַיִּפֹּ֞ל כָּל־ מַחֲנֵ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב לֹ֥א נִשְׁאַ֖ר עַד־ אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
passages.sermon:
Sisera was the commander of the Canaanite army.
He fled from the battlefield on foot.
He ran to the tent of Jael.
Jael was the wife of Heber.
Heber was a Kenite.
Jabin was the king of Hazor.
There was peace between Jabin and the family of Heber.
Sisera went to Jael’s tent because of this peace.
passages.original: וְסִֽיסְרָא֙ נָ֣ס בְּרַגְלָ֔יו אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל יָעֵ֔ל אֵ֖שֶּׁת חֶ֣בֶר הַקֵּינִ֑י כִּ֣י שָׁל֗וֹם בֵּ֚ין יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ חָצ֔וֹר וּבֵ֕ין בֵּ֖ית חֶ֥בֶר הַקֵּינִֽי׃

passages.text: Jael went out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord. Come in with me. Do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
passages.sermon:
Jael was the wife of Heber the Kenite.
Sisera was the commander of Jabin’s army.
Jael went out to meet Sisera.
She spoke to Sisera.
She said, “Come in, my lord.”
She said, “Come in with me.”
She said, “Do not be afraid.”
Sisera entered Jael’s tent.
Jael covered Sisera with a blanket.
passages.original: וַתֵּצֵ֣א יָעֵל֮ לִקְרַ֣את סִֽיסְרָא֒ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו סוּרָ֧ה אֲדֹנִ֛י סוּרָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י אַל־ תִּירָ֑א וַיָּ֤סַר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ הָאֹ֔הֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּ֖הוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָֽה׃

passages.text: Sisera said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty.” So she opened a container of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him again.
passages.sermon:
Sisera was a commander who fled from battle.
He came to the tent of Jael.
Jael was the wife of Heber the Kenite.
Sisera spoke to Jael.
He said, “Please give me a little water to drink.”
He said this because he was thirsty.
Jael opened a container of milk.
She gave Sisera a drink.
She covered him again.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלֶ֛יהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־ נָ֥א מְעַט־ מַ֖יִם כִּ֣י צָמֵ֑אתִי וַתִּפְתַּ֞ח אֶת־ נֹ֧אוד הֶחָלָ֛ב וַתַּשְׁקֵ֖הוּ וַתְּכַסֵּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: “Stand at the entrance to the tent,” he said, “and if anyone comes and asks you, ‘Is there a man here?’ say, ‘No.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Sisera was a Canaanite military commander.
He was fleeing from battle.
He entered Jael’s tent to hide.
Sisera spoke to Jael.
He said, “Stand at the entrance to the tent.”
He told her what to do if someone came.
He said, “If anyone comes and asks you, ‘Is there a man here?’”
He told her to answer, “No.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ עֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְהָיָה֩ אִם־ אִ֨ישׁ יָב֜וֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵ֗ךְ וְאָמַ֛ר הֲיֵֽשׁ־ פֹּ֥ה אִ֖ישׁ וְאָמַ֥רְתְּ אָֽיִן׃

passages.text: But as he lay sleeping from exhaustion, Heber’s wife Jael took a tent peg, grabbed a hammer, and went silently to Sisera. She drove the peg through his temple and into the ground, and he died.
passages.sermon:
Jael was the wife of Heber.
Sisera was sleeping because he was exhausted.
Jael took a tent peg.
She picked up a hammer in her hand.
She went quietly to Sisera.
She drove the tent peg through his temple.
She pushed the peg into the ground.
Sisera died.
passages.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח יָעֵ֣ל אֵֽשֶׁת־ חֶ֠בֶר אֶת־ יְתַ֨ד הָאֹ֜הֶל וַתָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־ הַמַּקֶּ֣בֶת בְּיָדָ֗הּ וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלָיו֙ בַּלָּ֔אט וַתִּתְקַ֤ע אֶת־ הַיָּתֵד֙ בְּרַקָּת֔וֹ וַתִּצְנַ֖ח בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהֽוּא־ נִרְדָּ֥ם וַיָּ֖עַף וַיָּמֹֽת׃

passages.text: When Barak arrived in pursuit of Sisera, Jael went out to greet him and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man you are seeking.” So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera dead, with a tent peg through his temple.
passages.sermon:
Barak was an Israelite leader.
Barak chased Sisera.
Sisera was the commander of the Canaanite army.
Jael was the wife of Heber.
Jael went out to meet Barak.
Jael spoke to Barak.
Jael said, “Come. I will show you the man you are looking for.”
Barak went with Jael.
Barak entered Jael’s tent.
Sisera was inside the tent.
Sisera was dead.
A tent peg was in Sisera’s temple.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה בָרָק֮ רֹדֵ֣ף אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָא֒ וַתֵּצֵ֤א יָעֵל֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ לֵ֣ךְ וְאַרְאֶ֔ךָּ אֶת־ הָאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵלֶ֔יהָ וְהִנֵּ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ נֹפֵ֣ל מֵ֔ת וְהַיָּתֵ֖ד בְּרַקָּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
God acted on that day.
God subdued Jabin.
Jabin was the king of Canaan.
God subdued Jabin before the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיַּכְנַ֤ע אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֵ֖ת יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנָ֑עַן לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites fought against Jabin.
Jabin was the king of Canaan.
The Israelites became stronger and stronger against Jabin.
They continued to fight him.
At last, the Israelites destroyed Jabin, king of Canaan.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֜לֶךְ יַ֤ד בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְקָשָׁ֔ה עַ֖ל יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנָ֑עַן עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרִ֔יתוּ אֵ֖ת יָבִ֥ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנָֽעַן׃פ
